definitionZh: 高度 CSS 属性指定元素的高度 。 默认情况下,属性定义了内容区域的高度. 然而,如果将框大小设定为边框,则它决定了边框区域的高度。
sourceDefinition: The height CSS property specifies the height of an element. By default, the property defines the height of the content area. If box-sizing is set to border-box, however, it instead determines the height of the border area.
